title: Ignite 2026: Office in Copilot GA; Copilot Code GA in December
summary: Microsoft's Copilot announcements: Home (Chat plus Cowork) is rolling out worldwide; Office in Copilot, which brings Word, Excel and PowerPoint into the Copilot app with files saved to OneDrive under existing permissions and sensitivity labels, is GA; Copilot Managed Runtime, which hosts apps built in Code, Cowork and Copilot Studio, is GA. Copilot Code (natural-language app building in a sandbox inside the tenant, managed in the Microsoft 365 admin center) is in the Frontier program, with GA planned for December. Autopilot, a long-running personal agent with its own agent identity that colleagues can @mention in Teams, is rolling out through Frontier. 'Today' (morning brief included with a Copilot licence; an all-day feed that uses Copilot credits) starts in private preview.
why: Copilot is turning into an app platform: users will create documents, apps and long-running agents from one place. Each piece lands on controls you already own (OneDrive permissions, labels, admin center app management, agent identities), but usage-based parts such as Today Feed consume Copilot credits.
todo: Do now: check that sensitivity labels and OneDrive sharing defaults are where you want them, because Office in Copilot saves into OneDrive with those controls.
Decide who may publish apps through Copilot Managed Runtime and how they will be reviewed before Copilot Code reaches GA.
Wait: Copilot Code GA (December), Autopilot and Today are Frontier or private preview — announced, not verified. Plan cost controls for credit-consuming features before enabling them.
effective_note: Office in Copilot and Copilot Managed Runtime GA; Copilot Code GA planned for December; Autopilot and Today in Frontier/private preview — per Microsoft.
